nonBlockingObservations.observation: familyRules.sharedBlobPairs records vite/vitest as 4 files and 16 lines. A blob-SHA recount matches that: four shared source blobs of at least 3 lines, 5+4+4+3. The README calls the import-meta.d.ts shim 1 line. The blob that meets the 3-line threshold is packages/vite/types/import-meta.d.ts, 5 physical lines, identical to packages/vitest/import-meta.d.ts. Shorter shared blobs exist and are excluded by the threshold. Sixteen lines stays under both materiality thresholds, so leaving the pair unmerged is unchanged.

nonBlockingObservations.observation: Seventy-four @aws-sdk/* declarations in aws-cdk package.json files are exactly 3.632.0, and yarn.lock resolves those clients at 3.632.0. One declaration is a range: packages/@aws-cdk/aws-imagebuilder-alpha/package.json devDepends on @aws-sdk/client-inspector2 at ^3, and aws-sdk-js-v3 provides that package at 3.1146.0, which satisfies ^3. Two fixture package.json files under packages/@aws-cdk-testing/framework-integ/test/ pin @aws-sdk/client-s3 at 3.1000.0. The @smithy/* declarations are exact 3.x (3.5.0, 3.7.2, 3.3.3, 3.3.4). The ^3 range is the dependency that can resolve, which fits the stated 33-of-34 split. constructs is 0.0.0.
